ModMetaData.name: Main Button Bar System
ModMetaData.author: NAI
ModMetaData.description:
Customise the bottom main button bar: reorder by dragging, hide, rename, set widths, pin to either end, and collapse rarely used buttons into a "More" drawer or let the bar scroll. Per-save settings with a default template, hotkeys for every button, custom and imported icons, six built-in themes (vanilla look by default), custom themes mixed button by button, "New theme" to make your own theme mod in the game, sharing of arrangements (with a report of what fits before importing, or as a Workshop-ready mod), 29 languages.
Nothing changes until you change something: a fresh install looks exactly like the game.
Works with mods that add icons, windows or buttons. Mods that take over the whole bar (TooManyButtons, Custom Bottom Bar, UI Not Included, DragReorder) are detected; you choose who draws it (importing their settings is experimental). Works with Better Sliders.
Settings: Options > Mod settings > Main Button Bar System, or the gear in the "More" drawer. For modders: API.md in the mod folder.
